title: 有所思
author: 佚名（汉乐府）
intro: A young woman hears her lover has been unfaithful — so she smashes the hairpin she meant to give him, burns it, and throws the ashes to the wind. Then, at dawn, she isn’t so sure. Fiery, honest and very modern.
analysis: 这是一首汉代民歌，写一个女子的爱和恨，感情变化非常快。开头说：我想念的人在大海的南边。拿什么送给他呢？一支镶着两颗珍珠的玳瑁簪子，还用玉缠绕起来——礼物越精致，爱得越深。可是突然听说他变了心，她马上把簪子折断、砸碎、烧掉，烧完还要迎着风把灰扬掉，说：从今以后，不再想你！跟你一刀两断！这一段动作一个接一个，又急又狠，把愤怒写得淋漓尽致。可是最后几句又软了下来：当初我们相会的时候，鸡叫狗吠，哥哥嫂嫂应该早就知道了吧。唉！秋风呼呼地吹，天快亮了，东方马上就白了，到时候就明白该怎么办了。“妃呼豨”是叹气的声音。这首诗用的是长短不齐的句子（杂言），像人说话时的语气，忽长忽短，正好写出她又爱又恨、拿不定主意的心情。
analysisEn: This Han folk song follows a young woman’s love turning into anger — fast. It begins: the one I love is far away, south of the great sea. What shall I send him? A tortoiseshell hairpin set with two pearls, wound round with jade. The finer the gift, the deeper the love. Then she hears he has someone else. At once she breaks the hairpin, smashes it, burns it — and, not satisfied, scatters the ashes into the wind. “From now on, I won’t think of you! I’m done with you!” One sharp action follows another, and her fury leaps off the page. But the last lines soften. When we used to meet, the roosters crowed and the dogs barked — surely my brother and his wife already know. “Fei hu xi!” — a long sigh. The autumn wind howls, dawn is coming, and soon the east will turn white; by then she will know what to do. The lines are of uneven length (a form called zayan, “mixed lines”), so they rise and fall like real speech — perfect for someone who can’t decide whether she loves him or hates him.
background: An anonymous song from the Han “Songs for Drums and Pipes” (鼓吹曲辞, also called 铙歌), a set of eighteen pieces preserved in the Song shu and the Yuefu shiji. Their wording is old and sometimes obscure; this one is among the clearest and most loved.
pronunciation: 遗 wèi（赠送）；玳瑁 dài mào；簪 zān；绍缭 shào liáo；当风 dāng；嫂 sǎo；飔 sī；高 hào（同“皓”，天亮发白，不读 gāo）。妃呼豨 fēi hū xī：表示叹息的声音，也有注本读 bēi xū xī（同“悲歔欷”），网站暂读 fēi hū xī。
version: 采用《乐府诗集》卷十六所收汉铙歌《有所思》的通行文本，全诗十七句（杂言）。网站按语意断行，分为三段：赠簪、毁簪、犹豫。“妃呼豨”三字是表声的衬词，《乐府诗集》未录，《宋书·乐志》等本有，网站从通行本保留。

lines.py: yǒu suǒ sī, nǎi zài dà hǎi nán
lines.lit: The one I think of is south of the great sea.
lines.en: The one I love lives far away, south of the great sea.

lines.zh: 何用问遗君？双珠玳瑁簪，
lines.rhythm: 何用/问遗君，双珠/玳瑁簪
lines.py: hé yòng wèn wèi jūn, shuāng zhū dài mào zān
lines.lit: With what shall I present you? A tortoiseshell hairpin with two pearls,
lines.en: What gift shall I send him? A tortoiseshell hairpin set with two pearls,
lines.tts: 何用问位君？双珠玳瑁簪，

lines.en: wrapped round and round with jade.

lines.zh: 闻君有他心，拉杂摧烧之。
lines.rhythm: 闻君/有他心，拉杂/摧烧之
lines.py: wén jūn yǒu tā xīn, lā zá cuī shāo zhī
lines.lit: I hear you have another in your heart; I smash it to pieces and burn it.
lines.en: Now I hear his heart has turned — I break the pin to bits and burn it.

lines.py: cuī shāo zhī, dāng fēng yáng qí huī
lines.lit: Smash and burn it, and facing the wind scatter its ashes.
lines.en: Smash it, burn it, and throw the ashes to the wind!

lines.py: cóng jīn yǐ wǎng, wù fù xiāng sī
lines.lit: From now on, I will not long for you again!
lines.en: From this day on, I’ll miss you no more!

lines.lit: My longing for you is cut off!
lines.en: Between you and me, the longing is over!

lines.py: jī míng gǒu fèi, xiōng sǎo dāng zhī zhī
lines.lit: Cocks crowed and dogs barked; my brother and sister-in-law must know of it.
lines.en: When we met, the roosters crowed and the dogs barked — my brother and his wife must know.

lines.py: qiū fēng sù sù chén fēng sī
lines.lit: The autumn wind whistles, the morning wind is cool;
lines.en: The autumn wind rushes, the dawn wind is cold;

lines.py: dōng fāng xū yú hào zhī zhī
lines.lit: in a moment the east will turn white, and I will know it.
lines.en: soon the east will grow light, and then I’ll know my mind.

words.en: the one I think of; my beloved

words.note: 古汉语常用词，相当于“是”“就”。
问、遗都是“赠送”的意思，古义。
一种海龟的壳，古代用来做首饰；今天“玳瑁眼镜”。
古义“折碎”；现代汉语“拉杂”指说话写文章杂乱无章。
现代汉语“摧毁”“无坚不摧”。

words.en: to cut off; to break up

words.note: 表示叹息的声音词，没有实际意思。
书面语，现代汉语“须臾不离”。
同“皓”，古义；不是“高低”的“高”。

imagery.name: 秋风
imagery.zh: 黎明前呼呼的秋风，吹出女子一夜未眠、心乱如麻的悲凉。
imagery.en: The cold autumn wind before dawn carries the bleakness of a sleepless night and a mind in turmoil.
